xterm.js for the live terminal view (js/views/terminal.js), vendored
unmodified so the app needs no CDN (the CSP allows only 'self').
MIT licensed: see LICENSE and LICENSE-addon-fit.

Source maps are left out (the files still name them; only devtools asks).
To update: `npm pack` both packages from the same xterm.js release, copy
the files listed above, re-check the CSP shims in terminal.js against the
new DOM renderer, and update this file.
